# YouTube Music

Music streaming service from Google, sold standalone or bundled with YouTube Premium.

## Market position

**~10.3% share** and the **fastest-growing global service in 2024** — a hair from overtaking Apple Music (MIDiA). Together with YouTube Premium ~125M paying (last disclosure 2024).

## Features vs Spotify

- **Bundle with YouTube Premium**: music + ad-free YouTube + background play at one price — a "two-in-one" Spotify doesn't have.
- **Student plan** (e.g. $5.49/mo in the US) aggressively targets the 18–24 segment.
- A catalogue beyond studio releases: remixes, live sets, covers from YouTube.

## Comparison

| Category | Where they stand |
|---|---|
| Price (individual) | **$10.99/mo** standalone; the **$5.49 student plan** aggressively targets 18–24 ([student plan](https://www.youtube.com/premium/student)) — and most buy it as the YouTube Premium bundle |
| Free tier | Yes — ad-supported, and the whole catalogue is on YouTube anyway |
| Audio quality | No lossless tier — streams cap at 256 kbps AAC |
| Algorithm control | "Thinks like YouTube, not a music player" — recommendations rated weaker than Spotify's by its own users (see User voices) |
| Library & ownership | Catalogue reaches past studio releases — remixes, live sets and covers straight from YouTube |

## User voices

- Among students the bundle is seen as "the best value-per-hour in college" — they buy ad-free YouTube and get music for free ([YouTube Premium Student](https://www.youtube.com/premium/student)).
- Typical complaint: music recommendations weaker than Spotify's, the app "thinks like YouTube, not a music player".

## What this means for our personas

- A direct threat to Jake ([The Value Auditor](../Archetypes/The%20Value%20Auditor.md) + [The Social Curator](../Archetypes/The%20Social%20Curator.md)): his friends already have the bundle — see [Tempted by YouTube Premium](../Signals/Tempted%20by%20YouTube%20Premium.md).
- YouTube is also the default "escape" when frustrated: in the test P3 said he'd "close the app and put something on YouTube" — [Skip track](../Signals/Skip%20track.md).
